decisions.reason: As a newly launched sensor module with its own product page, it is a visible and strategically central extension of the modular sensing platform, so management would continue backing it and attribute any early shortfall to normal market ramp-up.

Because this voltage measurement module was explicitly launched as the replacement for an earlier generation, dropping it after one year would contradict an announced upgrade path and waste development already committed to the core platform.

The MQTT proxy directly supports the firm's stated push into richer software and connectivity features and was presented publicly on its own page, making continued commitment likely despite any initial disappointment.

A CAN bus interface fits the firm's automation and embedded customer base and strengthens the platform's connectivity offering, so management would be inclined to keep it on the market rather than reverse course quickly.
This carbon dioxide sensor module is a clear platform-consistent sensing product with a dedicated page and recent launch, so the firm would likely persist and view weak early results as temporary.

Although somewhat more peripheral than core modules, the touch panel accessory was still launched publicly on its own page and complements the ecosystem, which under escalation of commitment favors retaining it for longer.
